faq.question: Is this a stock sentiment API for alerts?
faq.answer: Yes. It returns watchlist headlines as JSON with sentiment scores and keeps only negative items (sentiment at or below -0.1) for AAPL, TSLA, and NVDA.

faq.question: Why is Only new articles already on?
faq.answer: So scheduled runs skip headlines you already saw—ideal for Slack, Zapier, or webhook alerts without duplicate noise.

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No. Click Start for negative mega-cap news (up to 30 items, last 24 hours). Edit tickers after you duplicate the task.

faq.question: Can I change the sentiment threshold or tickers?
faq.answer: Yes. Duplicate the task, edit tickers or maxSentimentScore, then schedule it. Enrichment must stay on for sentiment filtering.
